steps.en: Officer spots a different mailing address for the same ID
steps.id: Officer melihat alamat surat berbeda untuk ID yang sama
steps.why_en: The system never compares the returned-letter address with the LTA mailing address.
steps.why_id: Sistem tidak pernah membandingkan alamat surat yang dikembalikan dengan alamat surat LTA.

steps.en: The resent letter goes to the LTA mailing address
steps.id: Surat kirim ulang dikirim ke alamat surat LTA
steps.why_en: The letter keeps using the registered address first, so the alternative address is mostly not used.
steps.why_id: Surat tetap memakai alamat terdaftar lebih dulu, sehingga alamat alternatif umumnya tidak terpakai.

steps.en: The suspended notice resumes automatically on its due date
steps.id: Notice yang ditangguhkan lanjut otomatis pada tanggal jatuh tempo
steps.why_en: Resuming is time-based, not triggered by an address decision.
steps.why_id: Pelanjutan berdasarkan waktu, bukan dipicu keputusan soal alamat.

steps.en: The reminder file for the printing vendor is created
steps.id: File reminder untuk vendor cetak dibuat
steps.why_en: Daily generation is switched off in code and only runs by manual trigger, which failed once in production.
steps.why_id: Pembuatan harian dimatikan di kode dan hanya jalan lewat pemicu manual, yang pernah gagal di production.

steps.en: The vendor receives the file to print and post
steps.id: Vendor menerima file untuk dicetak dan dikirim pos
steps.why_en: Upload to the vendor is switched off in the repository settings, and the real setting cannot be checked.
steps.why_id: Pengiriman ke vendor dimatikan di pengaturan repo, dan pengaturan aslinya tidak bisa dicek.
